title: phUSD-is-stake-AND-reward creates a structural conflict-of-interest: every claim mints fresh phUSD supply, dilution-bearing compounding spirals favour owner-aligned stakers
rootCause: phUSD is both the staking asset and a freshly-minted reward. `phUSDPerSecond` scales linearly with `totalStaked`, so the absolute mint rate grows with TVL. Compounding stakers' share of `totalStaked` grows faster than passive ones; combined with DEDUP-006 (uncapped APY), the spiral is unbounded.
impactSummary: Stated APY overstates real (dilution-adjusted) APY; passive stakers are diluted by sophisticated compounders; phUSD peg / value-anchor is under unconstrained supply pressure.
preservedDetails: ECON-009 carries the structural tokenomic framing and challenges profile §8.5's 'no invariant violation' label.
remediation: Cap phUSD mint at IFlax/governance layer; source rewards externally instead of fresh mints; publish dilution-adjusted APY; per-block mint cap on this contract.
dedupNotes: Adjacent to DEDUP-006 (the spiral is bounded by APY; with uncapped APY it's unbounded). Tagged as borderline — may be demoted to QA-level observability commentary rather than a standalone Medium.
